title: Ninja Warrior in Tavern
description: A muscular male ninja with purple hair, green headband and intricate white tattoos is captured mid-spin in a dynamic combat pose inside a wooden tavern. He wields two glowing curved blades with teal energy effects while surrounded by swirling white smoke, floating debris, broken wood, red blood splatter and hanging lanterns.
